ideas.title: Investigation into Minneapolis shooting
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the shooting of Alex Pretti by a Border Patrol agent, including potential patterns of misconduct and use of force by federal agents.
ideas.angle: The use of force by federal agents and potential patterns of misconduct
questions: What was the justification for the use of force?
Are there any patterns of misconduct by Border Patrol agents?
ideas.insight: The investigation into the shooting of Alex Pretti has the potential to uncover patterns of misconduct by federal agents and raise questions about the use of force in Minneapolis.

ideas.title: Minnesota Governor Tim Walz's response to shooting
ideas.description: An investigation into Minnesota Governor Tim Walz's response to the shooting of Alex Pretti, including any potential connections to Somali fraud allegations.
ideas.angle: The response of Governor Tim Walz to the shooting and potential connections to Somali fraud allegations
questions: What was Governor Walz's response to the shooting?
Are there any connections to Somali fraud allegations?
ideas.insight: The response of Governor Walz to the shooting of Alex Pretti and potential connections to Somali fraud allegations warrant further investigation.
